hints.title: Maximum Overlap Hamiltonian Reduction
hints.text: Minimizing the total merged superstring length is equivalent to maximizing the total character overlap across consecutive words in a permutation order.

hints.title: Pairwise Suffix Prefix Overlap Matrix
hints.text: Precalculate overlap[i][j], which stores the length of the longest suffix of word i that matches a prefix of word j.

hints.title: Traveling Salesperson Bitmask DP Procedure
hints.text: Define dp[mask][i] as the maximal total overlap visiting subset mask ending at word i. Record parent pointers for reconstruction. Find the terminal word achieving maximal overlap under full mask, reconstruct the sequence in order, and assemble the string using precomputed overlaps.

hints.title: Complete Implementation

variables: N: input size or search state bound
complexity.notes: Optimal solution achieving O(N^2 * 2^N) time and O(N * 2^N) auxiliary space.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Evaluating all n! sequence orderings is intractable for n up to 12.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: TSP-style bitmask DP stores O(n * 2^n) states and transitions in O(n^2 * 2^n) time.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate should convert the shortest superstring formulation into an equivalent maximum overlap TSP problem.
